name: Minimum Largest Order-Shattered Set of the Best-Mistakes/Order-Shattering Separation Class
proof: For example, applying the four binary downshifts in the order x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4 produces a down-closed family with largest support size one. No nonconstant class has order-shattering dimension zero. Thus the minimum over coordinate orders is one. The exhaustive calculation is in sync/verify_best_mistakes_order_shattering_gap.py.
